adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(popupAjaxError)` or other error handling. If the destroy request fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and the UI provides no feedback; the row will also remain because `deleteHost` is only sent in the `then` branch.
